cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22)
project(robot_runtime VERSION 0.1.0 LANGUAGES C CXX)
if(POLICY CMP0167)
    cmake_policy(SET CMP0167 NEW)
endif()
include(GNUInstallDirs)
include(CMakePackageConfigHelpers)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 23)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)
set(CMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
set(CMAKE_INSTALL_RPATH_USE_LINK_PATH TRUE)
option(ROBOT_RUNTIME_BUILD_MUJOCO "Build optional MuJoCo backend" ON)
option(ROBOT_RUNTIME_BUILD_SERIAL "Build Linux PAROL6 serial backend" OFF)
option(ROBOT_RUNTIME_BUILD_PYTHON "Build direct Python bindings" ON)
include(cmake/NativeSdk.cmake)
find_package(pinocchio 3.8.0 EXACT CONFIG REQUIRED)
find_package(Eigen3 REQUIRED NO_MODULE)
find_package(yaml-cpp CONFIG REQUIRED)
find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
include(cmake/Ruckig.cmake)
include(cmake/Sml.cmake)
add_library(robot_runtime_core INTERFACE)
target_compile_features(robot_runtime_core INTERFACE cxx_std_23)
target_include_directories(robot_runtime_core INTERFACE $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include> $<INSTALL_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR}>)
target_link_libraries(robot_runtime_core INTERFACE Eigen3::Eigen ruckig::ruckig robot_sml_headers Threads::Threads)
add_library(robot_runtime_model STATIC src/model.cpp)
target_link_libraries(robot_runtime_model PUBLIC robot_runtime_core PRIVATE pinocchio::pinocchio_parsers)
add_library(robot_runtime_sdk INTERFACE)
add_library(robot_runtime::sdk ALIAS robot_runtime_sdk)
set_target_properties(robot_runtime_sdk PROPERTIES EXPORT_NAME sdk)
target_link_libraries(robot_runtime_sdk INTERFACE robot_runtime_model yaml-cpp::yaml-cpp)
set(runtime_targets robot_runtime_core robot_runtime_model robot_runtime_sdk robot_sml_headers)
if(ROBOT_RUNTIME_BUILD_MUJOCO)
    include(cmake/Mujoco.cmake)
    add_library(robot_runtime_mujoco STATIC src/mujoco_backend.cpp)
    target_link_libraries(robot_runtime_mujoco PUBLIC robot_runtime_core mujoco::mujoco)
    target_compile_definitions(robot_runtime_mujoco PRIVATE ROBOT_MUJOCO_PLUGIN_DIRECTORY="${MUJOCO_PLUGIN_DIRECTORY}")
    target_link_libraries(robot_runtime_sdk INTERFACE robot_runtime_mujoco)
    target_compile_definitions(robot_runtime_sdk INTERFACE ROBOT_RUNTIME_HAS_MUJOCO=1)
    list(APPEND runtime_targets robot_runtime_mujoco)
    get_filename_component(mujoco_library_name "${MUJOCO_LINK_LIBRARY}" NAME)
    if(APPLE AND MUJOCO_FRAMEWORK_ROOT)
        install(DIRECTORY "${MUJOCO_FRAMEWORK_ROOT}/mujoco.framework" DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR})
        set(ROBOT_RUNTIME_INSTALLED_MUJOCO "${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}/mujoco.framework/Versions/A/${mujoco_library_name}")
    else()
        install(FILES "${MUJOCO_LINK_LIBRARY}" DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR})
        set(ROBOT_RUNTIME_INSTALLED_MUJOCO "${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}/${mujoco_library_name}")
    endif()
    install(DIRECTORY "${MUJOCO_INCLUDE_DIR}/mujoco" DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR})
endif()
if(ROBOT_RUNTIME_BUILD_SERIAL)
    if(NOT CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Linux")
        message(FATAL_ERROR "The PAROL6 serial backend requires Linux")
    endif()
    add_library(robot_runtime_serial STATIC src/serial_backend.cpp src/serial_protocol.cpp)
    target_link_libraries(robot_runtime_serial PUBLIC robot_runtime_core)
    target_link_libraries(robot_runtime_sdk INTERFACE robot_runtime_serial)
    target_compile_definitions(robot_runtime_sdk INTERFACE ROBOT_RUNTIME_HAS_SERIAL=1)
    list(APPEND runtime_targets robot_runtime_serial)
endif()
install(TARGETS ${runtime_targets} EXPORT robot_runtimeTargets ARCHIVE DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR})
install(DIRECTORY include/ DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR} FILES_MATCHING PATTERN "*.hpp")
install(FILES "${robot_sml_include}/boost/sml.hpp" DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR}/boost)
install(EXPORT robot_runtimeTargets NAMESPACE robot_runtime:: DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}/cmake/robot_runtime)
configure_package_config_file(cmake/robot_runtimeConfig.cmake.in ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/robot_runtimeConfig.cmake INSTALL_DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}/cmake/robot_runtime)
write_basic_package_version_file(${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/robot_runtimeConfigVersion.cmake VERSION ${PROJECT_VERSION} COMPATIBILITY SameMajorVersion)
install(FILES ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/robot_runtimeConfig.cmake ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/robot_runtimeConfigVersion.cmake DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}/cmake/robot_runtime)
if(ROBOT_RUNTIME_BUILD_PYTHON)
    find_package(Python 3.12 REQUIRED COMPONENTS Interpreter Development.Module)
    find_package(nanobind 3.1 CONFIG REQUIRED)
    nanobind_add_module(_native bindings/python/module.cpp)
    target_link_libraries(_native PRIVATE robot_runtime_sdk)
    if(ROBOT_RUNTIME_NATIVE_SDK_ACTIVE)
        set_property(TARGET _native APPEND PROPERTY INSTALL_RPATH "${sdk_prefix}/lib")
    endif()
    if(APPLE)
        set_property(TARGET _native APPEND PROPERTY INSTALL_RPATH "@loader_path" "@loader_path/../../lib")
    else()
        set_property(TARGET _native APPEND PROPERTY INSTALL_RPATH "$ORIGIN" "$ORIGIN/../../lib")
    endif()
    install(TARGETS _native LIBRARY DESTINATION python/robot_runtime_native COMPONENT python)
    install(FILES python/robot_runtime_native/__init__.py DESTINATION python/robot_runtime_native COMPONENT python)
endif()
